stories.title: Trump pushes DOJ to revive cases against ex-Olympian in Reflecting Pool incident
new_facts: Damage was caused by a botched contractor installation, not vandalism, per prosecutors.

A Trump-aligned advisor publicly warned Pirro she has more to worry about than the Reflecting Pool case.
Raskin sent letters to both Justice and Interior departments requesting records on the Hearn prosecution.
White House request to DOJ came one day after Todd Blanche was sworn in to lead the department.
PolitiFact quantified how often Trump publicly mentioned Reflecting Pool and White House ballroom over seven months of 2026.
Trump is pushing DOJ to open another case against David Hearn after charges were dropped.
House Judiciary Democrats, led by Raskin, launched a probe into Pirro and Burgum over the Reflecting Pool case reversal.
stories.line: Trump administration pressures DOJ to revive or open cases against an ex-Olympian related to an incident at the Reflecting Pool.

stories.title: Russia frees US Marine after four years in prison
new_facts: State Department says Gilman was freed without prisoner exchange or Washington concessions.

Gilman, 32, arrested Jan 2022 en route to English-teaching job in Moldova; father disputes charges.
Gilman held exactly 1,666 days; Fox frames release as part of a prisoner exchange.
Gilman was in a dissociative stupor for 47 days before being flown out of Russia.
stories.line: Russia released Robert Gilman, a US Marine imprisoned for four years, after US negotiations secured his freedom on humanitarian grounds.
